formula: P / (P + F + U); N/A is excluded
aggregation: Equal-weight mean of three planned positions within each task and method. Retained no-code positions contribute zero unless an explicitly recorded author-reported replacement score is used.
standard_deviation: Population standard deviation across the three position scores, divisor 3. Retained as a descriptive table field; not plotted or interpreted as a confidence interval.
input_difference: Direct-LLM did not receive the supplied application API. The other methods did.
interpretation: New tasks use whole numbered requirements; legacy tasks use original testcase reviews. Compare methods within a task. Do not pool denominators or interpret the six tasks as an equally spaced scale. Static support is not executable testcase success or hardware correctness.
author_reported_value: The third GPIO output / EmbedDev score is 100 percent from a direct author statement. Its candidate and review were not provided in the local evidence. The retained local result is not overwritten.
current_replacement: Crazyflie / ChatDev / DeepSeek r02 uses the selected unchanged rerun artifact and its fixed 46/100 static review. Host remains compilation-failing. Human review was attested by the author; the offline scripts do not independently witness it.
excluded_from_current_display: Motor tracking remains preserved in the historical export and source archive.
